0022600138.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 5th in the Central and 13th in the East) host the Houston Rockets (4-0, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West), who enter on a four-game winning streak. Houston is without Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (calf strain), all listed as out. The Bucks lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
